messages:
Riley (People Ops): Marta — welcome! Pasting a pragmatic first-week manager playbook + who-to-ask map. Copy into your hire folder and ping me if you want it vendor-branded. :tada:

Marta (new manager): Thanks Riley — can you flag any non-obvious steps? I may need budget visibility and recruiting handoff details early.

Riley (People Ops): Sure. High level: reduce blockers first 72h, set clear 1:1 rhythm, and get a mentor pairing for context. Short checklist follows (recommended order).

Pre-day (48h before start):
- Confirm laptop & accessories or request hot-desk equipment if working on-prem.
- Add recurring 1:1 (weekly) + 30/60/90 review blocks to calendar.
- Assign a peer mentor for week 1 shadowing (ask Leah if you want org suggestions).

Day 1 — People & orientation:
- 09:00 Team intro (30m): quick icebreakers + 3 immediate team priorities.
- 10:00 Manager expectations w/ Jordan (15m): decision rights & autonomy levels.
- 13:00 HR quick tour (benefits, accommodations) if relevant.
- 15:00 Mentor pairing: shadow standup + read-through of recent tickets.

Day 2 — Access & finance:
- Morning: IT handoff for Okta/SSO, Slack, email, VPN, analytics read, billing dashboard.
- 11:00 Finance sync with Priya (15m): budget access, cost center code, purchasing limits, and who approves spend.
- Afternoon: Request any required service accounts and CI perms.

Day 3 — Recruitment & ops:
- 09:30 Recruiting handoff w/ Leah (15m): open reqs, interview rubric, hiring prioritization.
- 11:00 Shadow a 1:1 with a direct report (observe cadence & feedback style).
- Afternoon: pick a small onboarding task (README, tiny metric fix, or interview question improvement) to ship.

By EOW — Goals & communication norms:
- Draft 30/60/90 outcome-driven goals (share w/ Jordan + Riley). Use metrics where possible.
- Publish communication norms (response times, async channels, meeting rules).
- Schedule 30-day skip-level (10m) and first-month hiring sync if you own hires.

Non-obvious items (callouts):
- Budget visibility: Finance read access is distinct from billing dashboard. Ask Priya for "cost center read" + purchasing workflow.
- Recruiting permissions: to shortlist candidates you need Reader role in Greenhouse; Leah/Recruiting grants this.
- Ergonomics/equipment: if you need standing desk or ADA accomodations, HR can fast-track within 48h.

Who to DM if blocked (fastest path):
- IT provisioning: @Ethan or #help-it (include corp email + SSH pub key).
- Budget & purchasing questions: @Priya (Finance).
- Interview & hiring process: @Leah (Recruiting).
- Templates + onboarding copy: @Riley (People Ops).

Ethan (IT): @Marta DM your corp email. If you will push code, generate an SSH key and paste your pub key into the Access Portal -> Tech Access. Example commands:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "marta@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
I'll pre-provision analytics read + billing view after Jordan approves the Access Portal request.

Priya (Finance): @Marta I'll give you cost center read and a purchasing playbook (who approves $0-5k, $5-25k, >$25k). DM me the project code and I'll attach it to your profile.

Leah (Recruiting): @Marta adding the recruiting primer: how to write scorecards, how we de-risk hires (work samples), and who to loop in for panel interviews. If you want, I can join your first hiring debrief in week 3.

Jordan (Hiring Manager): Quick note on decision rights: you can approve interview debriefs, low-risk infra changes, and onboarding README updates. Escalate infra config or budget >$25k to me. We'll set these boundaries in the week-1 expectations chat.

Riley (People Ops): Template links (SSO required): 30/60/90 outcome template, intro email draft, hiring playbook. If you want a copy in the hiring folder, say "please copy" and I'll add.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Complete payroll & benefits enrollment within 48 hours.

access-bot: Access Portal: request submitted for analytics and billing view. Status: pending manager approval (Jordan).

Marta (new manager): Thanks all 60A I'll DM Ethan my corp email & key, and Priya for the cost center. Riley 44D please copy templates into the hire folder. Appreciate the clear map.
